methodology.discovery: Broad recall only: explosion/loud/PVO plus strike-impact terms. Discovery cannot itself produce a strict verdict.
methodology.exact_city: Classification strips trailing publisher branding and requires a city alias in event text. Regional morphology or publisher name alone is not exact-city evidence.
methodology.strict_explosion: Requires exact-city explosion/impact/strike evidence. PVO-only and controlled quarry/blasting wording are not strict explosion evidence.
methodology.air_military_context: Audited terms cover air alerts, UAV/drone/Shahed, missiles, KAB/air bombs, Banderoл, Molniya, FPV, PVO, Air Force and fast aerial-target wording.
methodology.temporal_binding: Strict accepts explicit alert relation in event wording, explicit source-stated event clock inside the matched episode, or contemporaneous Telegram live wording whose publication is inside the episode. Publication time alone is never event time.
methodology.sensitivity: Requires one raw matched episode plus exact-city explosion/impact, aerial-war context and same-attack linkage, but allows missing strict temporal proof as historical inferred_same_attack sensitivity.
methodology.ambiguity: Real overlaps remain needs_review. Near-duplicate logical unique matches without one raw matched_episode_id also remain needs_review to avoid arbitrary metric propagation.
methodology.fulltext: Publisher full-text rescue remains manual-review-only in this step.
methodology.deterministic_rejects: Limited to controlled non-military blast wording, publisher-brand-only exact-city false positives, and complete Telegram PVO-only messages with no explosion/impact evidence.
